slice: Prebuild challenge for a two-sided Formation studio where synthetic Ghosts answer as consistent fictional people instead of asking the member to impersonate them.
sharedContext: Current UI says Shared Werkle / Decide what crosses the line. The Operator reasonably reads this as deciding whether another person's words crossed a personal boundary. Intended behavior is actually deciding which exact source wording or new joint wording enters the proposed shared company plan.

The selected Ghost already has a synthetic Workshop source and deterministic prefilled choices, but most reasoning is hidden. The page asks the member to switch actors and enter decisions as the Ghost, which weakens the simulation.
Target: member always answers as themself; Ghost has visible deterministic answers, opinions, counterpositions, and reasons across all twelve Formation topics.

Ghost depth may include work pace, follow-through style, decision style, disagreement style, risk posture, availability, contribution expectations, and a fictional financial scenario useful for negotiating a proposed Werkle.

Financial scenario must never use real account numbers, imply a real bank connection, claim Plaid verification, rank wealth, or leak a public amount. In a one-to-one practice Formation it may simulate a fictional disclosed band, spending boundary, liquidity timing, or refusal to disclose, all labeled synthetic/unverified.
No compatibility score. Differences are useful data, not failure. Ghost answers should vary coherently by member lane/profile rather than being twelve random quips.
The active Shared Werkle area should explain: compare my answer with the Ghost's answer; use mine, use theirs, write a third answer together, keep the subject private, or leave it unresolved.
The local draft must remain revisitable and may let the member reset/replay. Nothing contacts a real person or saves to an account.
Implementation is React/Next local preview only. No provider, schema/RLS, secrets, spend, push, deploy, or production action.
liveStrings: Build the answer you would both work from
Why Rosa sees it that way
Keep this out of the shared plan
knownGaps: Ghosts are fictional local test data, not autonomous accounts or real members.
No real second-member custody exists in this candidate.
Fictional funds posture is simulation data and never provider evidence.

ENDER.pull: Attack unclear language, member impersonation, flat Ghosts, random personality, uncanny dialogue, homework tone, and hidden consequences.
go: Return ENDER_M19_GHOST_AGENCY_GO, PATCH, or STOP with the two strongest UX corrections.
Define the exact active-topic hierarchy and plain member copy, including what replaces Decide what crosses the line.
Specify how a coherent Ghost personality changes at least six materially different topic answers without becoming cartoonish.
Give desktop, 390px, reset/replay, agreement, disagreement, and long-answer acceptance checks.
ENDER.momentum: Name the smallest buildable first stake and postbuild evidence owed, then stop.
ENDER.outOfLane: No code, credentials, schema/RLS, provider action, spend, push, deploy, subagent, or release approval.
